criteria: keyed answer is technically correct within approved evidence
explanation adds no claims beyond approved evidence
distractors do not create a second defensible answer

decision_semantics.description: A named human reviewer evaluates the exact private payload. The technical-review-agent only verifies and binds a human pass decision to the governed ledger.

authority_invariants: No final content approval is synthesized.
No public scenario question is created.
No assessment eligibility, scoring, delivery, API, or release authority is created.
Promotion into scenario_questions remains a later explicit governed phase.

recovery.provenance_pass_persisted_but_ledger_mis: safe; rerun with the same exact review evidence binds the missing governed transition
recovery.nonpass_same_payload_then_pass: fail closed; revise or replace the content before a new pass review

production_precondition: A real production profile with role developer_reviewer or technical_reviewer must exist. The current production role inventory contains only teacher, so no Phase 10E production transition is authorized yet.
